line: What if Stickman erased gravity?
visual: HOOK flash-forward: Stickman flying upside down among floating houses, cars and a cow, laughing; quick rewind swoosh

line: He took his pencil, flipped it around, and rubbed out one tiny word on the page: GRAVITY.
visual: Stickman sits on the porch steps with a notebook; flips the pencil to the eraser end; close-up: the word GRAVITY on the page is rubbed out letter by letter, eraser crumbs fly

line: For a second, nothing happened.
visual: Silence beat: Stickman looks around, blinks; a bird stops mid-air

line: Then his sock floated off the floor.
visual: A sock (drying on the porch rail) lifts and drifts up; he stares

line: Then his bed.
visual: Through the open window a bed floats up inside the house and bonks the ceiling

line: Then the whole house lifted off its foundations.
visual: Rumble; the yellow house rips off the ground with a chunk of lawn and rises, Stickman holds onto the porch railing, feet lifting

line: Cars drifted down the street like balloons.
visual: The blue and red cars float and slowly spin above the road

line: A cow floated past the window, still chewing.
visual: Gag: a cow drifts past the house window, calmly chewing grass

line: Stickman laughed, kicked off the ceiling, and flew.
visual: Stickman laughs, kicks off the porch roof and flies like a superhero, doing a loop

line: But the ocean was rising too.
visual: Camera tilts toward the horizon: water peeling up from the distant river/sea into the sky

line: Giant blobs of water wobbled into the sky, full of confused fish.
visual: Wobbling water blobs drift past, fish inside with confused faces

line: And the Moon was getting closer. Much closer.
visual: A huge Moon slides in and fills the sky; Stickman's face goes pale

line: Stickman panicked and tried to write GRAVITY back.
visual: He flips the pencil, starts to write G-R in midair

line: But the pencil floated out of his hand.
visual: The pencil slips and spins away; his fingers just miss it

line: He swam after it through the air, past a shark in a water bubble,
visual: He 'swims' (breaststroke) through the air past a grinning shark in a water bubble, which turns to look at him

line: grabbed it, and wrote one big word across the sky.
visual: He grabs the pencil and writes a giant glowing GRAVITY across the sky

line: Everything slammed back down.
visual: Smash cut: everything drops; BIG impact, dust and water splash, short camera shake

line: The house. The cars. The cow.
visual: Three quick hits on each word: house lands, cars bounce, cow lands on its feet

line: And one very surprised shark, sitting on his roof.
visual: Stickman sits on his roof next to a surprised shark in a puddle; they look at each other

line: What would you erase?
visual: Stickman looks at the camera holding the pencil eraser-up; big end question WHAT WOULD YOU ERASE? then SUBSCRIBE FOR MORE card in the last ~2.5 s
